## 09 – Error Handler (shared)
Set as "Error workflow" of 00–08. Builds a short, redacted summary (no stack, no data) and posts it to `ERROR_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL` (Slack or Discord incoming webhook) when configured.

nodes.name: Summarize error
nodes.notes: Redacts tokens, keys, JWTs and webhook URLs.

nodes.name: Send notification
nodes.notes: POST ERROR_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL (secret URL: keep it only in the environment).

nodes.name: Logged only
nodes.notes: The summary stays in the n8n execution log.
